Snapshot: candidate 82669fd69433962ff3b9c7070da8d2222e2667c9; frozen EN 6af98cb717755690a9ca793e5454a96ebd7a8f9f; accepted RU base 07f65c498184294831f87c5310c8c1cb001906e0. Opening and closing gates both passed; four new strokes raw-identical.
Scope: Completely read all requested guidance and three rubrics; all four EN/RU kanji lessons; nine EN/RU context pairs; two EN-only comparison lessons; 14 KANJIDIC2 records, radical evidence and header; 51 JMdict entries; four KanjiPedia entries; all 362 typed kanji rows; 12 proposals, four adjudications, four clarifications, four outside-limit records and all three exact navigation diffs. Every requested window returned completely with exit code 0. No web pages consulted.
C1 CLEAN: Readings, strokes, key 40 宀, JLPT/community metadata, compound readings, examples and explicitly modern mnemonic labels agree with the frozen source and read official evidence. The 4 lesson adjudications are supported within their selected introductory scope; no etymology presented as fact.
C2 CLEAN: Three existing-word diffs are exact standalone-glyph link wrappers to present kanji files; no prose, metadata or existing links changed. All new lesson links target existing RU files; unlinked EN-only word pages remain plain text. Independently checked each directed quiz pair against its exact current Russian titles and the read dictionary senses; no listed foil is a correct answer for its source title in this bounded pool. This does not certify UI fallback selection or all possible quiz compositions.
C3 CLEAN: Four lesson bodies are readable Russian for the stated beginner scope; Japanese forms remain intact. Navigation wrappers preserve their visible wording and improve direct access. No confirmed learner-comprehension defect.

N002客→害 S-intro; pool-safe: guest/customer vs вред/ущерб; shared 宀/口 shape is not semantic overlap.
N003客→字 S-intro; pool-safe: guest/customer vs письменный знак; 字’s letter, handwriting and village-section senses do not match.
N004害→客 S-intro; pool-safe independently: вред/ущерб vs guest/customer; no reverse-edge inference.
N005害→言 S-intro; pool-safe: harm vs говорить/слова; harmful speech is a context, not a match for the title.
N006害→書 S-intro; pool-safe: harm vs писать; book/document senses also do not match.
N007宿→客 S-intro; pool-safe: ночлег/гостиница vs guest/customer; co-occurrence of guest and lodging is not answer equivalence.
N008宿→百 S-intro; pool-safe: lodging vs сто/много; 百-shape resemblance is visual only.
N009宿→字 S-intro; pool-safe: lodging vs письменный знак; village-section sense of 字 is not lodging.
N010容→客 S-intro; pool-safe: вмещать/облик vs guest/customer; shared roof and lower-box appearance only.
N011容→宿 S-intro; pool-safe: вмещать/облик vs ночлег/гостиница; contain/accommodate adjacency is not title equivalence. 宿’s home/dwelling sense is not taught here and does not change this pair.
N012容→空 S-intro; pool-safe: вмещать/облик vs небо/пустой; container/empty association is not a shared answer.
L001客 SUPPORTED_WITHIN_INTRODUCTORY_SOURCE: facts, examples and visibly distinct lower 各 are supported; mnemonic explicitly disclaims history.
L002害 SUPPORTED_WITHIN_INTRODUCTORY_SOURCE: readings/examples and 有害な物 are supported; barrier is clearly mnemonic, not etymology.
L003宿 SUPPORTED_WITHIN_INTRODUCTORY_SOURCE: やど/シュク examples and 宿題 warning supported; 亻/百 are explicitly modern visual cues, not historical decomposition. Narrow title omits a dictionary home/dwelling sense without claiming exhaustiveness.
L004容 SUPPORTED_WITHIN_INTRODUCTORY_SOURCE: 容器/内容 and readings supported; visual vessel-mouth cue is explicitly mnemonic, not history. Title вмещать; облик is apt for taught meanings.
A001客 SOURCE-SUPPORTED, BOUNDED: every taught reading/sense and お客さん, 観客, 旅客 forms checked; no frequency claim.
A002害 SOURCE-SUPPORTED, BOUNDED: 害, 被害, 有害, 無害 and adjectival-noun status supported; 有害な物 is correct.
A003宿 SOURCE-SUPPORTED, BOUNDED: lodging and home/dwelling senses, 宿泊, 下宿, 宿題 and listed secondary senses checked; teaching is deliberately narrower.
A004容 SOURCE-SUPPORTED, BOUNDED: contents/substance and container senses support taught words; form/appearance senses exist, but cited 容 forms are rare/search-only and not taught.
NAV01 words/下宿.md: NAV-ONLY; exact wrapper at 宿; target exists; all other bytes/meaning retained.
NAV02 words/客.md: NAV-ONLY; exact wrapper at 客; target exists; all other bytes/meaning retained.
NAV03 words/宿題.md: NAV-ONLY; exact wrapper at 宿; target exists; all other bytes/meaning retained.
Outside LIMIT dispositions: O001客 LIMIT, not a new guard: 旅/店 adjacency noted; neither is this source’s distractor. O002害 LIMIT, not a new guard: 悪 adjacency noted; no direct edge. O003宿 LIMIT, not a new guard: 家/宅 home adjacency and 館/旅 lodging adjacency noted; no direct edge; title choice does not clear unrelated quiz fallback risk. O004容 LIMIT, not a new guard: 内/中 content adjacency noted; neither is this source’s distractor. EN-only 内容/害 word pages remain out of RU runtime.
Findings: none.
Optional: In 害.md, な-прилагательное is understandable; прилагательное типа な is slightly more natural Russian terminology. Optional wording only.
Limits: No app/UI quiz execution, fallback-option selection, test/build run, or whole-corpus semantic audit. Outside-limit adjacency records are not new quiz guards. KanjiPedia supports source shapes and readings, not learner outcomes or frequency. No external pages read.
